## Project

**Due:** December 4

**Overview:** You will be helping organize an undergraduate student research competition. This involves:

* Sending verification emails to faculty sponsors
* Determining which projects are valid competition entries
* Assigning judges to valid projects according to judging criteria
* Determining winning projects based on judge scores

**Note:** Most of these steps can be completed in parallel! If you are stuck on an "earlier" step, you can always work on a "later" step.

**AI use:** AI can only be used for small questions. It cannot generate big ideas and it cannot write important or substantial pieces of code for you. We will have in-class time to work on the project too, so you have me as a resource if you get stuck!
